utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don't think you signed up yet, Oren. But Gus is bringing his toolbox, so you can just bring any small items you need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, so I can just bring my toaster then? Or was I supposed to bring something else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, the toaster would be perfect, Oren. Just bring it along Saturday and we'll see what we can do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Bringing my tool kit and some spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Leo! I'll make sure you're on the volunteer list for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Saturday, not Sunday. I'll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Faye! Yeah, the repair drive's coming along... Rosa's gonna help me wrangle the volunteer list, just trying to keep track of who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so glad Rosa's on board! Should I send out a group text with the pickup schedule for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, if you could do that, that'd be awesome—just don't promise I'll have the final tool list ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by the drive this weekend and bring my toolbox in case anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be perfect, Gus! We'll definitely put you to work—and your toolbox might come in handy for the extra items on my list now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, just let me know what else you need and I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mara, I'm glad you're here. I need someone to help me log the items in order of arrival so we can keep a proper schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, Eli, I can help log the items. Let me grab a clipboard and we'll get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Mara. I've got a column for the item, a column for the arrival time, and a column for whose it belongs to. That should keep everything tidy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? Gus is bringing his toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh yes, but I just heard from Rosa that it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I hope everyone got the memo!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you're kidding me! I was just telling Gus it was Saturday. I hope he checked his messages, he was so excited to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! What kind of garden tools were you thinking of bringing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the community center, right! I've got some pruning shears and a hand trowel I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect! Every little bit helps. I'll make sure we have a designated station for garden tool repairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, a repair drive? I thought we were just fixing one fence — did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, no, Leo's got us on a bigger job—power issue with a device at the old mill. I'm bringing my wrench and screwdrivers, but no diagnostic gear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the old mill? I thought we were just fixing a fence — how did we end up there?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sam, did you hear we're teaming up with Gus for the repair drive? I think we'll make a good pair.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, that sounds like a solid plan! Gus is great with electronics, and I can handle the mechanical stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll focus on the small appliances—we should have a good system going.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, just a heads-up—I'm setting up that repair drive for this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. I'm bringing my old toaster, and Jules is rallying the gardening club to bring tools!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, great to hear the drive's coming together—I'll be there with my toolbox, but you'll have to excuse me if I'm a few minutes late; Saturday mornings are my slow-start days.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem at all, Dane! Glad you're coming with your toolbox; we'll have plenty to work on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, I'm glad I ran into you—I wanted to double-check the time for the repair drive on Saturday. Is it still starting at 9?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, 9 a.m. sharp! Vik's got the sign-in table set up in the park. Want me to introduce you to a few folks from the gardening club who'll be there too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That'd be great, Jules. I've got my toaster and blender ready, and I'd love to meet the gardening club members—maybe they can give me tips on fixing my rusty gate too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think Hana's been looking into it, but I'm not sure who's really in charge yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do we know if Hana has a plan, or is she just as in the dark as the rest of us?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure, honestly—I've just been picking up bits and pieces from folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's a great way to help out neighbors, and we could use more hands!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going to use that old drive to fix my router? Are you sure it's safe?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally safe, Kira! Vik’s got it all organized, and I’m rounding up folks with tools. You should see the crew we’re pulling together—it’s going to be a breeze!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some spare parts and tools. And I'll definitely take a look at Oren's toaster.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Rey! Just to confirm, the drive is Sunday at the community center, right? I want to make sure we have enough space and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, that's right — Sunday at the community center. I'll be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, I'm glad you're interested in the repair drive! I'm helping out too—what do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, mostly lawnmowers and Leo's old fridge, I think. Nothing too crazy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I can take a look at the lawnmower for sure. The fridge might need some special parts, though—I'll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, have you heard about that repair drive this Saturday? I'm trying to find out more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yes, the repair drive! I've been gathering supplies at my garage—stop by if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Cleo! I was hoping to borrow my cousin's truck to move stuff—so I should just swing by your garage to pick up the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're gathering at the community center from 10 to 4—bring any broken items you'd like to fix!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive! I was just trying to remember if I was supposed to bring my old toaster or if that was for something else... I'll be there though!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, bring that toaster! We'll have folks who can fix just about anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Faye, do you know for sure if the repair drive is at the old garage on Elm Street or the community center? I keep hearing different things.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at the old garage on Elm Street, Opal — I confirmed it with the owner this morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's a relief! I was getting mixed signals, but now I can mark it down for sure. Thanks for checking, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I'm late! So what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I'm not totally sure — I thought it was just a fence, but now it sounds like a big thing. Can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It's a community event where we fix up stuff around the neighborhood—fences, devices, whatever needs mending. I'm bringing my toolbox to help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll be there on Saturday with my tools, ready to lend a hand with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's awesome, Uli! I'm planning to set up the repair drive for this Saturday, so if you can bring your steady hand and any small tools, that'd be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Vik. I've got a small screwdriver set I'll bring along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira, I've got my toolbox ready—just say the word and I'll head over to Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, great, Gus! Did you hear when exactly they're starting at the community center? I've got my toaster and blender ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not sure about the exact time, but I think Jules might know—she's been organizing the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be there by 8 to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll see you at 8 then! I'll have the sign-in sheets ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring extra wrenches. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Tess. I have the repair drive schedule finalized — could you double-check the time slots with me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli! Oh, and did you hear Gus is bringing his toolbox? He's such a dear—should make things run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I did hear about Gus. I'll put him down for the 10 a.m. slot — does that work with your recollection?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina! The repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. We could really use your help coordinating if you're free!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at the community center? Who's running this thing, and what exactly are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's a whole team effort! Bo's coordinating the volunteers, Opal secured the space, and I'm wrangling the schedule — folks are bringing in everything from toasters to garden tools.
